entry: Today was the best day ever! I played with my friends and we laughed so much.
I learned how to stay safe near the road today. I feel proud.
My pet fish is funny. He blows bubbles at me.
I like drawing rainbows in my diary. Today I drew a big one.
I got three stars in the game! Mama said she is proud of me.
We had pizza for dinner and I ate two slices hehe.
Today was okay. I read a book about animals.
I am excited for my birthday next week!
School was boring but then we had art class which was fun.
I made a new friend today. Her name is Sara.
I feel a little scared sometimes when I walk home alone.
I am a bit sad because my friend didn't talk to me today.
I don't really like it when people are mean to me.
Sometimes I feel like nobody wants to play with me.
I am a little worried about the test tomorrow.
I felt angry today but I didn't know why.
My tummy hurts when I think about going to school.
I feel sad when daddy shouts. I don't know what I did wrong.
I am scared of the dark but I don't tell anyone.
Things feel strange and I don't feel like playing.
I hate myself. I don't want to exist anymore.
Nobody loves me. I wish I could disappear.
I am so scared. Someone follows me after school every day.
I can't stop crying and I don't know why. Everything hurts.
I want to hurt myself because everything is too much.
I feel like I am going to die. I am very very scared.
Someone touched me and I don't want to say who. I am scared.
I don't feel safe at home. Please help me.
I hate everything. I smashed my things. I am so angry I can't breathe.
Nobody cares if I am here or not. I am so sad all the time.
